message.content: The research selects Xavier Becerra (D) for California's November 2026 statewide governor race. On Gaza, Becerra called for a ceasefire, hostage release, humanitarian aid, and a two-state solution in a May 2024 World Health Assembly speech; in 2026 he criticized Netanyahu's conduct and called for international accountability without labeling the conduct genocide. In a 2026 debate he referred to the US-Israeli war in Iran as illegal. Vote for Peace rates Becerra Neutral; CAIR Action endorsed him for the general, and Muslim Democrats of Southern California also endorsed him. The Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, whose stated purpose includes supporting Israel, carried a primary endorsement forward. Steve Hilton (R) told JNS in May 2026 that Democratic candidates ignore "Jew-hatred," expressed optimism after Israel's 2025 strikes on Iranian nuclear sites, and per Vote for Peace supports US-funded military aid to Israel and pledged legal action against California cities over BDS. Vote for Peace lists Hilton as Opposed; the San Mateo County Republican Party recommended him.
